Rashi on Kiddushin 12b:11:3.hebrew: שקלתא - כלומר, נקטא לה ולא השלכתה, ואישתיקה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 12b:11:3.english: She took it - That is to say, she held on to it and did not throw it down, and was silent.

Rashi on Kiddushin 12b:11:4.hebrew: הויא שתיקה דלאחר מתן מעות - שמתחילה, כשקיבלתה והמעות היו בתוכה, לא ידעה בהן; וכשידעה אחר כן ושתקה — שתיקה דלאחר מתן מעות היא, ולאו כלום היא. דהאי דשתקה משום דלא איכפת לה, מימר אמרה: מעיקרא לאו אדעתיה דהכי קבילתינהו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 12b:11:4.english: This is silence after the money is given - For initially, when she received it and the money was inside it, she did not know about it; and when she found out afterward and was silent — it is silence after the money is given, and it is nothing. For the fact that she was silent was because she did not care [to protest]; she said [to herself]: "From the outset, it was not with this in mind that I received them."

Rashi on Kiddushin 12b:12:1.english: From where do I state this - That silence after the giving of money is nothing.

Rashi on Kiddushin 12b:12:2.hebrew: בשעת מתן מעות - אם קודם שקבלתן אמר לה: ״התקדשי לי בו״ — מקודשת, דכי קבילתיה, אדעתא דהכי קבילתיה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 12b:12:2.english: At the time the money was given - If, before she received them, he said to her, “Be betrothed to me with it,” she is betrothed, for when she received it, [it was] with this intention that she received it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 12b:13:1.english: By inference, the first clause - For it does not distinguish between [whether] she wanted and [whether] she did not want.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 12b:12:1.hebrew: בשעת מתן מעות מקודשת - ה"ג, ולא גרסינן: "בין רצתה בין לא רצתה", כדאמר לקמן (קידושין דף יג.): "ליתני מקודשת סתם כי התם":
Tosafot on Kiddushin 12b:12:1.english: "At the time the money was given, she is betrothed" - This is the correct reading, and we do not read: "Whether she wanted or did not want," as [the Gemara] says later (Kiddushin 13a): "Let it teach 'she is betrothed' without qualification, like there."
